description: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - Mandatory Declarations

mrp.legal_rule: Rule 6(1)(e) - Mandatory declaration of MRP inclusive of all taxes

net_quantity.legal_rule: Rule 6(1)(b) - Declaration of net quantity in standard metric units (g, kg, ml, l)

mfg_date.legal_rule: Rule 6(1)(d) - Month and year of manufacture or pre-packing must be stated

manufacturer_name.legal_rule: Rule 6(1)(a) - Name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer

consumer_care.legal_rule: Rule 6(1)(f) - Name, address, phone number or email of consumer complaint contact
